text:
amira k: Hey team — quick benefits/payroll questions from my first week :wave:

amira k: 1) When does health insurance actually kick in? I filled the enroll form during onboarding but didn’t see an effective date.

amira k: 2) I bought a monitor for my home office before my card arrived — where do I submit a reimbursement?

amira k: 3) PTO/holidays: is accrual prorated for mid-year starters?

sarah liu: welcome, amira! :tada:
sarah liu: Health insurance is effective on the 1st of the month following 30 days of employment. Based on your start date (2025-06-03) your coverage should begin 2025-07-01. I’ll confirm with benefits and post back if anything changes.
sarah liu: For reimbursements, use the Expenses form (Finance) — https://redwood.example/expenses — attach the receipt and select category "equipment". Finance needs manager approval before payment.
sarah liu: PTO is pro-rated for the calendar year when you join mid-year. See policy: https://redwood.example/policies/pto (summary: accrual starts on day 1, available balance calculated pro-rata).

jonathan p: FYI payroll is biweekly on Fridays. First payroll that includes reimbursements depends on the payroll cutoff; if you submit by the Tuesday before payday we can include it.

jonathan p: Expense quick checklist (so it passes automated checks):
```
expense_type: equipment
amount: 129.99
receipt: monitor_receipt.pdf
purchase_date: 2025-06-15
manager_approval: sarah.liu@redwood.com
```
jonathan p: Submit via the form and then mention @sarah liu for approval — finance will route to AP after approval. Reimbursements processed within one payroll cycle after approvals.

amira k: Thanks — that helps a lot. Do I need to enroll dental/vision separately or is that included? Also who should I ping for manager approval if I don’t have their email?

sarah liu: Dental and vision are separate enrollments in the benefits portal (link in the enrollment confirmation email). I just checked — you weren’t auto-enrolled, so please pick dental/vision plans if you want them.
sarah liu: Manager approval: your manager is Alex Moore (alex.moore@redwood.com). If you need me to nudge them I can.

amira k: Great — I’ll submit the expense and enroll in dental today. Thanks! :raised_hands:

peopleops-bot: Enrollment submitted: Health plan and benefits enrollments for amira k recorded (ref BEN-9876). Benefits team will email confirmation within 5 business days. If you have questions, reply here or file a ticket at https://redwood.example/hr-support.
